newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa faces attack on support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa faces attack on support.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa is heading for an assault on support, technical analysts said.
Traders called it to open unchanged.
"Cocoa has some quite serious problems," independent technical analyst Elli Gifford said. "It has now run out of steam and it's eroding the psychological and actual support around 1,000 stg.
Its next target was 990 stg, with further support at the recent low just above 980 stg, she said.
But selling pressure was diminishing, which meant that that level should hold for now, Gifford said. "If it breaks, it's in serious trouble."
"We have now had two consecutive closes below the uptrend line, which should signal a test of 980 stg support, then 956 stg and 938 stg - our favoured target," brokers GNI said.
New York cocoa ended moderately higher in light turnover on Wednesday, bolstered by a late round of local short-covering, dealers said.
French chocolate group CEMOI is building a new cocoa processing factory in Ivory Coast which will open in October 1997, the company's managing director said on Wednesday.
"The factory can process 60,000 tonnes of beans a year," Managing Director Patrique Poivrier told Reuters by telephone from CEMOI's headquarters at Perpignan, in the south of France.
He put the cost of the project at 160 million French francs.
